# Concepts

* [Can two teams share one account? (Advanced plan)](can-two-teams-share-one-account-advanced-plan.md) - Two teams can share one account under a data-sharing agreement, and Advanced access is granted per case to named people.
* [Can two teams share one account? (Standard plan)](can-two-teams-share-one-account-standard-plan.md) - Two teams can share one account under a data-sharing agreement, and Standard access follows the team by default.
